run_codegen: run protoc with the gRPC plugin to generate Python messages and gRPC stubs from route_guide.proto
run_protoc_main: run grpc_tools.protoc.main to compile a .proto file into Python and gRPC Python output
generate_grpc_stubs: generate Python gRPC stubs from the route_guide.proto definition file using protoc
generate_python_out: generate Python message classes from the route_guide.proto file into the current directory
review_run_codegen: review the run_codegen script that invokes protoc to generate gRPC Python stubs
